spec: NeuraiZK/v3 C7 privacy pool notes, contrib/privacypool/privacy-c7/README.md

constants.personalizations_note: BLAKE2b of the empty string with each zero-padded personalization

negatives.name: record-length
negatives.why: 229 bytes

negatives.name: record-version
negatives.why: version byte 0x01 (C6 HPKE record)

negatives.name: epk-invalid ffffffff
negatives.why: epk is not a canonical ristretto255 encoding

negatives.name: epk-invalid 01000000
negatives.why: epk is not a canonical ristretto255 encoding

negatives.name: epk-invalid 26948d35
negatives.why: epk is not a canonical ristretto255 encoding

negatives.name: epk-identity
negatives.why: epk encodes the identity

negatives.name: epk-altered
negatives.why: valid but different epk: the tag check fails first (deterministic for this vector)

negatives.name: vtag-altered
negatives.why: view tag flipped

negatives.name: ct-altered
negatives.why: ciphertext bit flip

negatives.name: cm-other-in-publication
negatives.why: cm is in the AAD: a different published cm fails authentication

negatives.name: cm-mismatch
negatives.why: sender authenticated with the published cm, but the note commits to another cm

negatives.name: epk-not-from-rho
negatives.why: ZIP 212 analogue: epk != [esk(rho)]G_d although S matches

negatives.name: pk_d-not-of-d
negatives.why: note carries pk_d of address (0,1) but d of address (0,0)

negatives.name: index-out-of-range branch-2
negatives.why: d inverts to j=8589934597: branch > 1 or index >= 2^31

negatives.name: index-out-of-range index-2^31
negatives.why: d inverts to j=2147483648: branch > 1 or index >= 2^31

negatives.name: index-out-of-range index-2^32-1
negatives.why: d inverts to j=4294967295: branch > 1 or index >= 2^31

negatives.name: index-out-of-range branch-1-index-2^31
negatives.why: d inverts to j=6442450944: branch > 1 or index >= 2^31

negatives.name: owner-foreign
negatives.why: malicious sender: pk_d of A, owner of B; the receive-only scanner shows it unverified

negatives.name: note-amount-zero
negatives.why: authenticated note with amount 0

negatives.name: note-other-instance
negatives.why: authenticated note for another assetId

negatives.name: other-account
negatives.why: note of account B scanned by account A

negatives.name: vtag-collision
negatives.why: note of account B whose tag matches under A's ivk (rho search: 155 tries)
